summary: Skilled IT professional with 7 years of proven success in developing and leading cross‑functional technical teams to execute and deliver major technology initiatives using Agile methodology and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Well‑versed in managing projects with co‑located and off‑site teams, gathering and translating requirements, leading scrum teams, and owning the release management lifecycle for multiple applications across different environments.

experience.title: Information Technology Project Manager
responsibilities: Supported SCADA upgrade project, implementing technology tools for resource planning and real‑time collaboration.
Introduced SAFe to prioritize fiscal year acquisition and procurement needs.
Developed annual planning process for capital improvement activities.

experience.title: Agile Project Manager
responsibilities: Transitioned risk‑assessment tools to a web‑based platform.
Developed project plans, cost estimates, and tracked budget and resource allocation.
Managed project communication, gathered performance metrics, and identified risks.
Participated in quarterly SAFe PI planning events.

experience.title: Release Manager
responsibilities: Negotiated, planned, and managed all release activities, ensuring deployment readiness.
Facilitated production readiness reviews and release retrospectives.
Served as primary contact with IT partners, optimized platform capabilities, and performed root‑cause analysis.
Tracked release metrics and conducted configuration audits to meet CMMI standards.

experience.title: Business Analyst / Scrum Master
responsibilities: Facilitated requirements meetings, grooming sessions, and daily scrums.
Captured and translated requirements via Jira and Confluence.
Tested applications across development, staging, and production environments.
